topic: Capstone Demonstration, Review, and Future Enhancements
learningObjectives: Present the capstone architecture, implementation, and key features.
Evaluate the project against functional and technical requirements.
Identify realistic improvements for future versions.

activities.title: Capstone Storyboard
activities.instruction: Arrange the key sections of a technical capstone presentation.

content.concept: A clear technical demonstration can move from the problem and requirements to architecture, implementation, demonstration, results, and future improvements.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

activities.title: Architecture Walkthrough
activities.instruction: Explore the major components involved when a client request reaches the capstone application.

content.concept: An architecture walkthrough explains how a request travels through interfaces, application logic, data access, and external services.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

descriptions: Sends an HTTP request to the application.
Receives the request and selects the appropriate endpoint handler.
Validates and structures incoming request data.
Handles communication with the persistence layer.
Stores or retrieves persistent application data.
Carries the resulting data or error information back to the client.

activities.title: Feature Review Selector
activities.instruction: Choose the evidence that best demonstrates whether a requirement was satisfied.

content.concept: A capstone review should connect each requirement to implemented functionality and evidence such as tests, API responses, screenshots, or demonstrations.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.

choices: A passing automated test for the required behavior
A screenshot of unrelated source code
A feature name without implementation evidence
An undocumented assumption that the feature works
config.answer: A passing automated test for the required behavior

activities.title: Future Roadmap Builder
activities.instruction: Assemble a practical roadmap for future capstone improvements.

content.concept: A future roadmap should turn observed limitations and opportunities into concrete improvements such as better scalability, security, performance, usability, and functionality.
content.tip: Interact with the example first. Your progress is saved for this session.
